Now, we introduce our main new results on the fractional Schrödinger, the wave and the Klein-Gordon equations on compact manifolds.

1.2. Fractional Schrödinger equation. Suppose p ≥ 2, q < ∞ and 1 = 2(½ - 4). We divide these sharp Schrödinger admissible pairs (p, g) into four groups. See Figure 1. (1) Subcritical regime: d ≥ 1, 2 ≤ q < 2+1) (ii) Critical point: d ≥ 2, g = 2(d+1) (iii) Supercritical regime: d = 2, 2a+1 < q < 00 or d ≥ 3, 2d+1 < q < 24 (iv) Keel-Tao endpoint: d ≥ 3, g = 2½.
